For a 4-night business stay, these are three practical options:

Radisson Hotel Gurugram Udyog Vihar — around ₹7,500–9,000/night. Strong for Udyog Vihar/Cyber City access; breakfast, Wi-Fi and free-cancellation rates are available depending on package. 
MakeMyTrip

Hyatt Regency Gurugram — around ₹8,000–10,000/night. Better suited to NH-48/Manesar-side meetings, with a larger full-service business-hotel setup. 
The Gurugram House

Lemon Tree Premier, City Center, Gurugram — around ₹4,000–6,000/night. More budget-conscious, centrally located in Sector 29; breakfast and cancellation depend on the selected rate. 
Goibibo

Check before paying: breakfast inclusion, exact cancellation deadline, GST invoice eligibility, and whether Wi-Fi is complimentary.

For 20 delivery vehicles in Ahmedabad, these are three practical India-available offers. Prices are indicative/current published rates; hardware, GST and installation can change the final quote.

Option	Price for 20 vehicles	Reliability / limitations	Purchase terms
LocoNav	~₹8,000–16,000/month	Mature fleet platform, GPS + fuel/driver monitoring; exact hardware/support package varies	Usually quote-based; verify device warranty, installation and lock-in
Fleetx	~₹8,000+/month software starting point	Strong route, geofence, ETA and fleet analytics; hardware may be separate	Demo/quote; verify hardware, SIM, installation and add-on charges
TrackOlap	Quote-based; published plans support 20+ vehicles	Live tracking, alerts, trips, driver behaviour; basic plans have fewer features	7-day trial, quarterly billing; GST extra; upgrades allowed anytime, downgrades only after term 
TrackOlap

Market benchmark: basic GPS hardware is roughly ₹3,000–₹7,000/vehicle, with ₹200–₹600/vehicle/month typical for hardware + subscription. 
Fleetx
+1

Before paying: confirm Ahmedabad installation coverage, 4G/2G fallback, SIM/data ownership, 12/24/36-month total cost, replacement SLA, cancellation/early-exit fees, and whether hardware is AIS-140 certified if required.
